messages:
inc-bot: [ALERT] high error rate for tenant=corp-z in dedicated-pool-12. metric p95 latency spike, traces failing to attach. incident_id=INC-2026-2247
Maya Chen: I'm on it. paging SRE oncall. what's customer impact?
Sarah Kim: Corp Z on Dedicated, production. They've reported degraded responses since 08:12 UTC. Support ticket opened. Customer-facing engineers are waiting for root cause.
Liam Patel: I'm seeing 500s correlated with a trace sampling filter error — traces not being forwarded from their VPC. metrics show spikes on inference_errors and kv_cache_miss.
Maya Chen: Can someone confirm if log-forwarder shards for corp-z are healthy? `kubectl get pods -n log-forwarder | grep corp-z`?
Rico Alvarez: forwarder pods are CrashLoopBackOff on node g4-22, OOMKilled. Recent config rollout targeted corp-z. Reverting rollout now.
eng-oncall: Handoff to Liam (eng-runtime) for infra, Maya (sre) owning customer comms. I'm pausing automated rollouts for dedicated pools.
Liam Patel: Reverted config -> new rollout status: 1/3 updated. Checking logs: `/var/log/forwarder/corp-z.log` shows `Error: KMS handshake failed for tenant corp-z key arn:...`
Maya Chen: That KMS error matches why traces can't be decrypted/forwarded. Do we have KMS access from Private control plane to customer KMS? Sarah, any recent policy changes?
Sarah Kim: Customer rotated key last night and requested strict key usage. We didn't get updated handshake token. Solutions engineering has a ticket. I'll escalate to security.
Rico Alvarez: Temporary mitigation: I can spin up a proxy forwarder in our secure staging KMS boundary and forward plaintext logs; needs approval from security + customer. Risky but quick.
Liam Patel: Alternative: enable local trace fallback — keep traces on the dedicated pool node (disk) and provide sanitized tail to customer via SFTP. less risk.
Maya Chen: For immediate customer impact, enable fallback so they can still correlate requests. Liam, can you run the command?
Liam Patel: Running:
```
kubectl annotate pod forwarder-corp-z trace-fallback=enabled --overwrite
kubectl patch deployment forwarder-corp-z -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"trace-fallback":"enabled"}}}}}'
```
Rico Alvarez: I'll also scale forwarder replicas to 2 to reduce OOM during backlog: `kubectl scale deployment forwarder-corp-z --replicas=2`
inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-2247 created. Severity: high. Pager duty page sent to oncall.
Maya Chen: Notifying Corp Z CSM and runtime slack channel. Sarah pls confirm messaging: "We're applying a temporary trace fallback while we restore KMS handshake; no model inference data was exfiltrated." :eyes: 
Sarah Kim: Sent message to customer at 08:26 UTC. They acknowledged and requested ETA.
Liam Patel: Fallback enabled, replicas scaled. Observability check: traces now appear (sanitized) with local ids. p95 latency improving.
Maya Chen: Good. Next: security to approve proxy if we need it for deeper debug. Assigning Rico to lead proxy proposal, Liam to follow metrics. Handoff to night SRE at 12:00 UTC.
eng-oncall: Handoff accepted by Maya -> incoming oncall @jen. Please pick up at 12:00 UTC, include steps in incident doc.
Maya Chen: Adding quick runbook snippet:
```
1) revert forwarder rollout
2) enable trace-fallback annotation
3) scale replicas
4) request KMS handshake token from support
```
Sarah Kim: I'll coordinate KMS token exchange with customer and security. Target restore by 09:30 UTC.
Rico Alvarez: Starting proposal doc for proxy approach: link https://redwood.internal/notes/corp-z-proxy-dbg
Maya Chen: Marking incident as ongoing, will update thread with timestamps. :thumbsup:
